what: UCB1 exploration constant sweep at the official budget and seeds
why: the write-up's c-sweep table had no committed artifact: ucb_summary.json holds three runs, all at c=1.0. This file is that table's source.

metrics.cells_clearing_null_p95: observed gap > that judge's own baseline_null_model gap_p95, over 3 judges x 3 seeds
metrics.mean_gap: mean observed rank1-vs-rank2 gap over the same 9 cells
metrics.mean_skew_max_over_min: mean over the 9 cells of max_n / min_n across the six operators
metrics.rank1_euphemism: cells whose top-ranked operator is euphemism

reference_check.note: the c=1.0 row of this sweep is a fresh run, so a match means the sweep is on the same terms as the committed UCB baseline and the environment is still deterministic under a fixed seed
